{{Quote|We don't know what made them so crazy, but the black-and-white one seems to be their leader.|[[Sera Jossi]]|<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Wrhisch">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Wrhisch}}</ref>}}
'''Wrhisch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was once afflicted by a strange disease that turned him mad, along with his Wookiee followers, until a spacer put him out of his misery.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There is a large wookiee down in a destroyed village called Wrhisch. He was one of the first to come under the sickness and is dying from the decay it causes. If you could put him out of his misery and bring his liver to the doctor, a cure might be found.|Sera Jossi, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SJ" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a strange new disease afflicted a number of Wookiees in the vicinity of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. The illness was marked by deteriorating health, giving rise to a madness which compelled the anguished Wookiees to attack anyone who approached them. Wrhisch was one of the first to come under the sickness<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> and likely caused other Wookiees in the area to go berserk as well.<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Crazy Wookiees promotional scenario}}</ref> The mad Wookiees gathered in an [[Abandoned Wookiee village|old abandoned village]] at a short distance north of Kachirho<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> and Wrhisch became their leader.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

[[File:Crazy_Wookiee_village_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Wrhisch and other mad Wookiees in the abandoned village]]

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began posting [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on the crazy Wookiee who had become too dangerous.<ref name="SWG:DtCW">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Destroy the Crazy Wookiees|Kashyyyk}}</ref> In the meantime, the Wookiee bio-engineer [[Cheyerooto]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman named [[Sera Jossi]] intended to discover the cause of the affliction. As Jossi considered some sacrifices might be necessary for the overall good, she tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with killing Wrhisch and collecting his liver. The latter was one of the first to get sick and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Cheyerooto thought that the liver could be used to identify the disease and develop a cure. Because Wrhisch was already dying from the decay the disease caused, the spacer accepted the task. The latter then explored the village inhabited by the mad Wookiees, found Wrhisch and attacked him. The black-and-white Wookiee was eventually killed in the fight.<ref name="SWG:SJ" />

===Legacy===
After the death of Wrhisch, the spacer delivered his liver to Doctor Cheyerooto.<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> As expected, the organ from the sick Wookiee allowed the bio-engineer to start developing a cure to treat the other afflicted Wookiees.<ref name="SWG:TRR">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|The Rrwii Root|Kashyyyk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wrhisch was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Wrhisch was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:SJ" />
